يستثمروا (form X)
# يَسْتَثْمِرُوا (yastaṯmirū) /jas.taθ.mi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَثْمَرَ (istaṯmara)
# يُسْتَثْمَرُوا (yustaṯmarū) /jus.taθ.ma.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَثْمَرَ (istaṯmara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
